blocks.content: The Twelfth Schedule specifies the powers, authority and responsibilities of Municipalities.

items: Count of Subjects: 12th Schedule contains 18 functional subjects, whereas the 11th Schedule contains 29 subjects.
Constitutional Provision: Linked specifically to Article 243W for Municipalities.
Amendment Distinction: 74th Amendment Act (12th Schedule - Urban Local Bodies) vs 73rd Amendment Act (11th Schedule - Rural Panchayats).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Twelfth Schedule was added to the Constitution of India by the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992.
It specifies the powers, authority, and responsibilities of Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities).
Contains a total of 18 functional items under the jurisdiction of Municipalities.
Key subjects include urban planning, land use regulation, public health, slum improvement, and urban poverty alleviation.
